📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I search abbreviations?

Yes — the search box filters by abbreviation or expansion instantly.

How do I copy an abbreviation?

Click any row to copy the abbreviation itself.

Which Emmet features are covered?

Nesting, siblings, multiplication, grouping, attributes, text, classes/ids, and numbering.

Which editors support Emmet?

Emmet works in VS Code, Sublime, and most editors — these are the standard abbreviations.
